verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Factory can take an issue that a person has already assigned to it in Linear or Jira, then investigate and implement it. It also lists integrations with Jira, Linear, and PagerDuty. None of the evidence documents automatic triage of incoming issues, severity suggestions, or routing to an owner; delegating an already-assigned issue is a different capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner
